operations.title: A perfect coefficient-Betti pair canonically supplies an integral symplectic double
operations.statement: For a perfect pairing C x B -> Z, V=C direct_sum B has canonical nondegenerate alternating form omega((c,b),(c',b'))=<c,b'>-<c',b>, with C and B complementary Lagrangians and a canonical integral Heisenberg extension. Thus perfect paired Mackey fibers derive the algebraic phase plane for xp dynamics, but not positivity, a real Hilbert representation, hbar, dual cutoffs, or their self-adjoint boundary law.
operations.scope: Algebraic paired-module theorem; no physical relative-chain pushforward or Hilbert-Polya operator.

operations.title: Perfect-pairing symplectic nondegeneracy test
operations.procedure: Contract an arbitrary vector (c,b) against all vectors in C direct_sum B. Use perfectness separately against B and C to test the radical.
operations.expected_result: The radical is zero and both summands are maximal isotropic. A nonzero radical under a perfect pairing falsifies the theorem.
